name: S&B Foods Inc
summary: S&B Foods Inc., established in Tokyo, Japan in 1923, specializes in the production and distribution of a wide array of food items. The company's core business revolves around manufacturing and selling powdered spices, including curry, pepper, and garlic, for the Japanese market. Beyond its fundamental spice offerings, S&B Foods' extensive product portfolio encompasses convenient tube-packaged spice pastes, diverse seasonings, pre-made curry and stew sauce mixes, ready-to-eat retort pouch meals, various refrigerated food options, fresh herbs, and a selection of herb-related as well as other general food products.
